outputs.name: default
outputs.description: The default Vite configuration object for building the picker library. It applies when Vite loads this config module, uses the Svelte plugin and the src/utils/providerPickerEntry.ts library entry, and fixes output settings to dist/picker, the iife format, the HarnessPicker global name, and the picker file name with emptyOutDir enabled and CSS code splitting disabled; the Svelte plugin contains callback hooks that JSON cannot express.
